remarks: Executive retreat overlooking PeeknPeak Resort's premier golf course. This exceptional 5 bedroom 5 and one half bath residence showcases numerous recent updates including new flooring throughout, fresh interior paint, plank feature walls, and new Pella sliding doors. An extended driveway allows for additional guest parking spaces. Expansive windows and soaring ceilings fill the home with natural light, while the stunning floor to ceiling stone fireplace serves as the centerpiece of the great room. The main level features a spacious primary suite complete with a walk-in closet, dual vanities and jetted tub. Theres's an additional suite on the upper level with a recently updated bathroom. Thoughtfully designed for convenience including two laundry areas, and additional family/game room, a mudroom with storage right off the 2-car garage, a loft for home office use, playroom or exercise area. Endless possibilities for this flex space. Granite countertops throughout the home including a chef's dream kitchen with upgraded appliances. There are two HVAC systems keeping the entire home comfortable. Step outside to the expansive deck, featuring an automated retractable awning and sweeping golf course views. The elevation of the home provides incredible sunset views and captivating watch of wildlife.  The lower-level patio is home to a private hot tub which is included with the property. Offered fully furnished, this turnkey luxury residence is ready to enjoy as your year-round home, vacation retreat or investment property. HOA which is managed on-site includes exterior maintenance, snow and trash removal, cable and internet and use of homeowner's only pool.
